children: Windward Bio Group said its initial public offering of 10.3 million shares priced at $17 each.
The Basel, Switzerland, company had expected to sell 10.3 million shares at a price between $16 and $18 each. Its largest stockholders include Novo Holdings and OrbiMed.
Windward also sold stock and warrants to Sanofi in a $50 million private placement concurrently with the IPO.
Shares will trade on the Nasdaq Global Market under symbol WWB.
In September, Windward reported positive interim results from the Phase 2 portion of a clinical trial evaluating twice-yearly dosing of WIN378 in asthma.
